title: Research Accelerated by AI
excerpt: How AI is accelerating scientific discovery by field.
content:
Introduction: Discovery Support

　AI is not a tool that replaces researchers' judgment. It functions as a discovery engine that expands the search space and surfaces promising candidates faster.
Below is a field-by-field summary of notable cases where AI has advanced discovery.


1. Medicine and Drug Discovery

  • Protein Structure Prediction
    　Google DeepMind's AlphaFold predicted previously unresolved protein structures with high accuracy, accelerating drug discovery and disease-mechanism research.
  • Discovery of New Antibiotics
    　An MIT research team used AI to extract molecular structures overlooked in existing datasets, leading to candidates such as Halicin.
  • Higher-Precision Cancer Detection
    　Pathology image analysis has shown improved detection of early cancer signals.

2. Materials Science and Physics

  • New Material Discovery
    　Google DeepMind predicted new crystal materials from millions of candidates, significantly widening the search space for batteries and semiconductors.
  • Candidate Selection for Superconductors and Batteries
    　Stability simulations helped researchers narrow promising materials before running physical experiments.

3. Astronomy and Space Science

  • New Exoplanet Discovery
    　AI analysis of NASA datasets detected planet candidates that had been missed by manual review.
  • Support for Detecting Gravitational Waves and Other Phenomena
    　AI extracted meaningful patterns from noisy observational data.

4. Biology and Evolutionary Research

  • Gene Function Estimation
    　AI predicted functions of previously uncharacterized genes and suggested potential disease links.
  • New Species Classification
    　Computer-vision models supported extraction and classification of potential new species.

5. Mathematics and Algorithms

  • New Mathematical Conjectures
    　AI increasingly proposes patterns and conjectures that are then formally proved by human mathematicians.

6. Climate and Environment

  • New Climate-Pattern Detection
    　AI extracted abnormal trends from long-term datasets, contributing to improved disaster forecasting.
  • Identification of Greenhouse-Gas Emission Sources
    　Combining satellite data with AI helped visualize previously unclear emission sources.

7. Language and Humanities

  • Ancient Manuscript Decipherment
    　AI has been used to restore damaged texts and estimate structural patterns in previously undeciphered languages.

Conclusion: Research Capability in the AI Era

　From medicine and materials to space, climate, and the humanities, AI is already making overlooked candidates visible across many domains.
However, real value emerges not when AI suggestions are accepted as-is, but when they are rigorously filtered through domain expertise and validation workflows.
The next generation of research capability will depend on how well we divide the work: AI handles large-scale exploration, while humans design the right questions and verification process.
